notes.title: Patchnotes 0.1.1
notes.content:
We just released a patch to fix an issue where players would not see how many coins they've put into the pressure washer upgrading stations. We used this opportunity to add a small mud-monster prototype which you can find in the garage.

[list]
[*] Fixed missing UIs on vending machines
[*] Added a muddy monster in the garage
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0 Patchnotes
notes.content:
In this newest update, we added a small new area to the level.

[h2]New Area[/h2]
[list]
[*]3 new objects to clean
[*]The new area connects the main area with the platform where the temple is located so players who don't want to fly can access it by foot
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added settings for smooth rotation and toggling the pressure washer on & off
[*]Fixed shader, so some objects from Sketchfab which were previously loaded in pure white are now loaded with color
[*]Fixed bug where power washers would sometimes not clean until turned off and on again
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.19
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to the second patch update since our Early Access release! :)

As we're still getting a lot of feedback about various issues and bugs, we've mainly focused on bug fixes again. (Thanks to everyone who helped us pinpoint those bugs!)

Here's what we changed:

[list]
[*] Changed color of boost button on pressure washers to red for better visibility.
[*] Improved Valve Index controller support.
[*] Moved respawn point (when falling out of bounds) to center of lab.
[*] Fixed pressure washers colliding with player body while flying.
[*] Fixed movement & flying issues, caused by a bug where players were self-colliding with own head.
[*] Fixed racing reward coins getting stuck if picked up by other players.
[*] Fixed voice chat not being spatialized (3D).
[*] Fixed a bug where buttons could not be pressed when cleaning-bombs were held.
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes 0.0.18
notes.content:
This is our first patch after the Early Access launch last week.
[b]Thank you all for your feedback so far! :)[/b]

In this patch, we...

[list]
[*] Improved Sketchfab download reliability.
[*] Added some visual highlights to various points of interests.
[*] Made the dog’s bum cleanable.
[*] Fixed issues in the dog AI.
[/list]
